issue.title: nav-hotkeys parent picker classifies bank_month notes as records (missing from PARENT_RULE_NON_RECORD_TYPES)
issue.description: bob-plugins plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys/src/208-parent-note-picker-model.js keeps PARENT_RULE_NON_RECORD_TYPES = {article, mail, day, done, type}. Any typed note outside that set classifies as a record, and bank_month is not in the set, so bank/YYYY-MM.md notes (type: [[bank_month]]) classify as records in parentRuleKindOf. Consequence: the parent picker applies record parent rules to bank month notes (e.g. refusing non-album parents with not-record-parent), even though their canonical parent is the bank hub. First reported by the cld researcher in the bank-hub demotion swarm; lead verified the set contents on bob-plugins master (fast-forwarded 2026-11-26). Fix is likely adding bank_month to the set (and auditing 242d albumSchemaEntryKindOf for the same omission) plus a pinning test. Keep this separate from the bank.md area-type demotion epic.

task_type_fields.impact: Parent picker gestures on bank month notes get record semantics (wrong parent-kind refusals); low frequency since month-note parents are machine-written, but confusing when it fires.
task_type_fields.repro: Read the set at 208:22-28: bank_month is absent, so parentRuleTypeNames/parentRuleKindOf classify a type: [[bank_month]] note as a record. Exercise the parent picker on bank/2026-11.md and observe record parent rules applied.

issue.creation_reason: Verified during lead consolidation of the bank-hub demotion research (research:202611/bank_hub_demotion/bank_hub_demotion__final.md): bank month notes misclassify in the parent-rule model, independent of the bank.md area-type question.
